reaction: It was satisfying to see the pieces come together, and the contrast between signals in nerves and materials in blood was clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the signalling ends was most worthwhile: the three-panel sequence made it clearer how a signal reaches an ending and messengers cross the gap.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was straightforward, though the marked stub helped show what was still missing.

surprise.text: I noticed that nerve cells need a continuing blood supply as well as parts for sending signals.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave a reason for each pairing.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how nervous tissue connects to another body system. This chapter made the basic message path understandable, though its choices were mostly straightforward.
